svg.title: p99 latency per workload: Eski, Redis, Valkey and Dragonfly
svg.desc: Small multiples, one panel per workload with its own scale. Bars are medians of the valid repetitions, whiskers the observed minimum and maximum, hollow circles excluded repetitions.
svg.text: p99 latency, median of valid repetitions with observed range
milliseconds, lower is better; each panel has its own scale
